variants.name: variant-v4-no-hooks
variants.description: V4 ablation: full donnyclaude install except .claude/hooks/ is excluded. Used by ablation-django-13128 round to test whether the hooks directory (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart hooks) is responsible for the V4 regression on django__django-13128. Uses install_full_donnyclaude composite mutation with params.exclude=['hooks'].
